functional.question: How many sellers are there?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many products are in the catalogue?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders are there in total?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders have been delivered?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders were cancelled?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many distinct product categories are there?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) FROM products LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories have the most products, using the Portuguese category names?
functional.sql: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products AS p JOIN category_translation AS ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What is the average product weight in grams?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(product_weight_g) AS average_product_weight FROM products JOIN category_translation ON products.product_category_name = category_translation.product_category_name WHERE category_translation.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 states have the most sellers?
functional.sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY seller_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders were placed in 2017?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the highest price paid for a single item?
functional.sql: SELECT MAX(price) AS highest_price_paid FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id WHERE orders.order_status IN ('delivered', 'invoiced', 'processing', 'created', 'approved') AND NOT orders.order_approved_at IS NULL AND NOT orders.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NULL AND NOT orders.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

functional.question: How many order items are there?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_item_id) FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers generated the most revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: Which 5 product categories generated the most revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT pt.product_category_name_english AS product_category, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation AS pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY pt.product_category_name_english ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What is the average freight value per item?
Which 5 sellers sell the most distinct products?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS distinct_product_count FROM sellers AS s JOIN order_items AS oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY distinct_product_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders are there in each status?
functional.sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE NOT order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY order_status LIMIT 10

functional.question: What was the total revenue in 2017?
functional.sql: SELECT SUM(T2.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS T1 JOIN order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.order_approved_at) = '2017' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 products generated the most revenue?
What is the average number of items per order?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS average_items_per_order FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 seller states generated the most revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_state, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders contain more than one item?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders AS T1 JOIN order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id GROUP BY T1.order_id HAVING COUNT(T2.order_item_id) > 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers received the most orders?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What is the total freight cost across all order items?
functional.sql: SELECT SUM(freight_value) AS total_freight_cost FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories have the highest average item price?
functional.sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, AVG(oi.price) AS average_item_price FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'invoiced', 'processing', 'created') GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY average_item_price DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders were placed in each year?
functional.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which month of 2017 had the most orders?
functional.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY month ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

functional.question: What is the average item price?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(price) AS average_item_price FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers have the highest average item price?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, AVG(oi.price) AS average_item_price FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY average_item_price DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What was the total revenue in each year?
functional.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', order_approved_at) AS year, SUM(price) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id WHERE NOT order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many sellers have sold products in more than 3 different categories?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS seller_count FROM order_items JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id GROUP BY seller_id, product_category_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) > 3 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories have the highest freight cost as a share of revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue, SUM(oi.freight_value) AS total_freight_cost, (SUM(oi.freight_value) * 100.0 / SUM(oi.price)) AS freight_cost_share FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY freight_cost_share DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: Which 5 product categories are sold by the most distinct sellers?
functional.sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.seller_id) AS seller_count FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY seller_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What is the average revenue per seller?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, AVG(oi.price) AS average_revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY average_revenue DESC LIMIT 10

functional.question: How many orders were delivered later than the estimated delivery date?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.order_id) FROM orders AS T1 JOIN orders AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id WHERE T1.order_status = 'delivered' AND T1.order_delivered_carrier_date > T2.order_estimated_delivery_date LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers generated the most revenue in 2018?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' AND NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What share of orders were cancelled?
functional.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS canceled_order_share FROM orders LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers have the highest average freight cost per item?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, AVG(oi.freight_value) AS avg_freight_cost FROM order_items AS oi JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'invoiced', 'processing', 'created') GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY avg_freight_cost DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many sellers generated more revenue than the average seller?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(seller_id) AS seller_count FROM (SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id) AS seller_revenues WHERE total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT SUM(price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id) AS seller_revenues) LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories have the heaviest average product weight?
functional.sql: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english, AVG(p.product_weight_g) AS average_weight FROM products AS p JOIN category_translation AS ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name WHERE NOT ct.product_category_name IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english ORDER BY average_weight DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders have not been delivered yet?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status <> 'delivered' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the average delivery time in days?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(CAST((JULIANDAY(order_delivered_carrier_date) - JULIANDAY(order_purchase_timestamp)) AS INTEGER)) AS average_delivery_time FROM orders WHERE NOT order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the average time in hours between an order being placed and approved?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG((STRFTIME('%s', order_approved_at) - STRFTIME('%s', order_purchase_timestamp)) / 3600) AS average_time_hours FROM orders JOIN order_payments ON orders.order_id = order_payments.order_id WHERE order_payments.payment_type = 'credit_card' OR order_payments.payment_type = 'debit_card' OR order_payments.payment_type = 'voucher' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the average revenue per order?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(T2.price) AS average_revenue_per_order FROM orders AS T1 JOIN order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id WHERE NOT T1.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which single order had the highest total value?
functional.sql: SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

functional.question: Which 5 customer states generated the most revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT c.customer_state, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: Which 5 customer states have the highest average order value?
functional.sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(oi.price) AS average_order_value FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'invoiced', 'processing', 'created') GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY average_order_value DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: Which 5 customer cities placed the most orders?
functional.sql: SELECT c.customer_city, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_city ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many customers have placed more than one order?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS num_customers FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What share of customers are repeat buyers?
functional.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT T2.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.customer_unique_id) AS repeat_buyer_percentage FROM customers AS T1 JOIN orders AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which payment types are used most often?
functional.sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM order_payments JOIN orders ON order_payments.order_id = orders.order_id GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payment_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What is the average number of payment instalments?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(payment_installments) FROM order_payments JOIN orders ON order_payments.order_id = orders.order_id WHERE NOT orders.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the total value paid by credit card?
functional.sql: SELECT SUM(payment_value) AS total_credit_card_payments FROM order_payments JOIN orders ON order_payments.order_id = orders.order_id WHERE NOT orders.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND payment_type = 'credit_card' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories generated the most revenue, named in English?
functional.sql: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation AS ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders were paid in more than one instalment?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM order_payments WHERE payment_installments > 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the total item revenue from orders paid by credit card?
What percentage of orders were paid by credit card?
functional.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.order_id) AS credit_card_percentage FROM orders AS T1 JOIN order_payments AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders were paid using more than one payment type?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT payment_type) > 1) AS orders_with_multiple_payment_types LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders were paid with a voucher combined with another payment type?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.order_id) FROM order_payments AS T1 JOIN orders AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id WHERE T1.payment_type = 'voucher' AND NOT T2.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the median delivery time in days?
Which 5 customer states have the slowest average delivery time?
functional.sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(JULIANDAY(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS average_delivery_time FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY average_delivery_time ASC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What share of order items were bought from a seller in the same state as the customer?
Which 5 customer states rely most on sellers from other states?
functional.sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(s.seller_state) AS seller_count FROM customers AS c JOIN sellers AS s ON c.customer_id = s.seller_id WHERE c.customer_state <> s.seller_state GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY seller_count DESC LIMIT 5
